Sam (PM): Lighthouse confirmed they need private deploy + HSM and a p95 SLA. Target: staging by quarter end.
Ravi (Runtime): HSM + tight p95 in private infra requires KV caching + quant checks. Need infra slot.
Tess (Infra): We have 1 prewarm slot free but it's promised to Beacon. Can reassign with a 10-day delay for Beacon.
Sam (PM): Lighthouse ok with a staggered canary (10% -> 50% -> full) to buy time.
Nora (Security): HSM integration needs attestation and a short pen test after infra is up. Estimate ~12 business days total.
Ravi (Runtime): I'll prepare the rollout playbook and include fallback to hosted variant. Add tracing and token-level metrics for canary.
Tess (Infra): If slot moves, infra (VPC, peering, routes) ready in ~7 days. Need sign-off by EOD Tue.
ops-bot: Reminder: create "Lighthouse private pilot" ticket on launch-lane board: /boards/launch-lane.
Sam (PM): Action items: (1) Sam -> negotiate slot move with Beacon; (2) Tess -> infra template once confirmed; (3) Ravi -> playbook + telemetry by next Wed; (4) Nora -> schedule attestation/pen test. I'll mark this customer-driven high priority. :thumbsup:
